summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the escape format "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal and returning that result, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (mocked, Windows only) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and Black, since repository code execution was not permitted and Black is not installed; line lengths checked by reading. Nothing committed.
